PLAN "12-Week Strength + Hypertrophy (Start 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Increase total-body strength and lean mass"

PHASES

      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
